name: Lagerplatz Pfadfindergruppe Hall in Tirol
beschreibung: The Loretto Scout Camp of the Hall in Tirol Scout Group is the heart of the local group and is located in the municipality of Hall in Tirol in the Tyrolean Inn Valley, around five kilometres east of Innsbruck. The site serves as a place for playing, building, celebrating and being together; group meetings, camps, activities and evenings around the campfire take place here. Originally the area was an overgrown meadow, which the group gradually developed over many hours of work. Little by little, fire pits, seating, storage facilities and a container facility were created, offering space for materials, workshop work and preparation meetings, and it was recently extended. The Hall in Tirol Scout Group belongs to the Tyrolean provincial association and to the Scouts of Austria (PPÖ).
kurzbeschreibung: Loretto Scout Camp of the Hall in Tirol Scout Group, a close-to-nature group and camp site in the Tyrolean Inn Valley
